visual: Black-purple young leaves fade dark green · white orchid-like summer flowers
water: Moderate; water during prolonged dry spells
prune: Prune minimally; stool in spring for larger foliage
hardinessNote: H6; young growth can be damaged by late frost
resilience: generally pest free · honey fungus resistant
uncertain: RHS accepts Catalpa × erubescens 'Purpurea' and lists Catalpa bignonioides 'Purpurea' as a synonym
RHS gives ultimate dimensions above 12 m high and above 8 m wide; specialist tree sources give approximately 10-15 m by 6-10 m
RHS specifies full sun while specialist UK nursery guidance allows light dappled shade; sunMin reflects that limited tolerance
peak combines the distinctive purple spring foliage with the summer flower display
honey fungus resistance is supported by specialist UK nursery guidance rather than stated on the RHS cultivar profile
